topic: deep-archival routines for repository history: joining git and Linear event history into a corpus, fitting sphere-geometry RSI curves on it, and refreshing the archive on a cadence

subtopics.scope: Techniques for joining git event history (PRs, commits) with Linear issue data via reference regexes, merge_commit_sha links, and graceful fallbacks when identifiers are missing.
seed_queries: cross referencing pull requests with project management issues join design
git merge_commit_sha pull request commit link semantics

subtopics.scope: Incremental refresh design for a cached archive of repo events: since/from/linear-since delta fetching, cache invalidation windows, and idempotent merges.
seed_queries: incremental api sync since parameter delta fetching design
cache invalidation strategy polling data mirror stale

subtopics.scope: Hyperspherical-harmonic curve fitting on 9-D corpus points: PCA top-2, stereographic S2 lift, Mobius reparameterization, R-squared holdout, sparse-cell detection.
seed_queries: spherical harmonic regression machine learning sphere
PCA two components stereographic projection points on sphere

subtopics.scope: Deriving and validating a primitive-coverage basis (has_sha, has_linear_ref, has_state_progression and kin) for event corpora with regex detection and spot-check validation.
seed_queries: feature engineering detection regex event metadata corpus
binary feature vector corpus coverage analysis validation

subtopics.scope: Recursive self-improvement loops applied to an archive: gap-mapping, hypothesis-driven edits, fresh-context subagents, fixpoint rules, and cycle caps with user override.
seed_queries: recursive self improvement LLM agent bounded loop
fixpoint criterion iterative agent self improvement

subtopics.scope: Injecting deep-research topics into the archive via parallel subagents (deep-dive, prior-art, comparative), appending results as new corpus items and re-fitting the curve.
seed_queries: parallel subagent research orchestration LLM agents
deep research workflow multi agent synthesis report

subtopics.scope: Prior art on repo-history summarization: git changelog generators, repo summarizers, Linear Insights, and why none joins git plus planning data plus RSI.
seed_queries: git changelog generator conventional commits tools comparison
open source repository summarization AI tools

subtopics.scope: Output shape for a refreshable history archive: session JSON snapshots, fit metrics, gap-map markdown, changelog audit trail, and refs/ canonical summaries with status comments.
seed_queries: audit trail design data pipeline artifacts provenance
keep a changelog convention documentation releases

subtopics.scope: Operational limits: API rate caps, curve fit cost at 100k+ commits, asymmetric joins, PR body truncation, empty-join sparse cells.
seed_queries: linear api rate limits authenticated requests per hour
github api pagination large repository performance limits
